laws.rule: Smoking or dropping cigarette butts on Patong Beach is prohibited except in designated smoking areas. The penalty is up to one year's jail and/or a fine of up to THB 100,000. DMCR Order 864/2563 (2020) covered 24 beaches for two years; a later renewal has not been confirmed here.
laws.heading: Department of Marine and Coastal Resources, beach smoking order

laws.rule: Cannabis flower needs a Thai prescription. Shops in tourist areas openly selling it for smoking may be operating outside the law, and authorities are checking them.
laws.heading: TAT notice, 27 June 2025

festivals.what: Phuket Vegetarian Festival (Jia Chai), held from the first to the ninth night of the waxing moon of the ninth Chinese lunar month, at Chinese shrines across Phuket. In 2026 it ran 10 to 18 October, with Iw Keng street processions from 11 to 18 October, the Ham Si Iw Keng night procession of more than 40 shrines in Phuket City on 11 October, and the farewell to the Jade Emperor and the Nine Emperor Gods on the night of 18 October. Shrine rituals include fire-walking (Koi Hoi) and bridge-crossing (Koi Han); crowds gather on Thalang Road, Phuket Road and Surin Circle.
Songkran 2026 in Phuket: Phuket Water Festival 11 to 13 April at Baan Mai Khao and Patong Beach; Songkran on Dibuk Road and Dragon Plaza, Phuket Town, 13 April.

moving_calendars: Vegetarian Festival: first to ninth night of the ninth Chinese lunar month (re-dated each year, usually late September or October).
culture-cycles.note: A Thai government events listing gave 9 to 18 October for the 2026 Vegetarian Festival (search snapshot); TAT's 10 to 18 October is recorded.
